question: How do I make a booking?
answerHTML: Check live availability and pay a 50% booking deposit to secure your candles and date, or email yourself a quote. The remaining hire balance plus a refundable bond equal to the full hire fee are due 7 days before pickup. We will email a secure Stripe payment link. Pickup is the day before your event.

question: Why do I need to pay a refundable bond?
answerHTML: A refundable bond is required with all bookings as a standard safeguard for non-returned or seriously damaged items. In normal hire situations, it is returned in full after your candles are returned and checked. Our candles are packed carefully for transport, so this is simply a standard precaution rather than something most customers need to worry about.

question: Can I cancel my booking?
answerHTML: Because your booking reserves stock and your event date in advance, 50% of the candle hire fee is non-refundable once a booking is confirmed. If you cancel within 14 days of your event date, the full candle hire fee is non-refundable. Any refundable bond paid will be returned in full if the booking is cancelled before collection or pickup.
